title: Refactor JoinBlockCubit to call getByInviteCodeAsync instead of getAllAsync().where(...)
objective: Replace the getAllAsync() + .where((b) => b.inviteCode == inviteCode).first client-side filter in JoinBlockCubit.joinBlock with a direct call to ICarnivalBlocksRepository.getByInviteCodeAsync(inviteCode).
description: JoinBlockCubit.joinBlock (lib/ui/carnivalBlock/joinBlock/cubit/join_block_cubit.dart, lines 33-82) currently fetches every carnival block in the system and filters by invite code locally. After H2a lands a typed getByInviteCodeAsync method, the cubit should call that method directly. The fix replaces lines 50-65 (the blocksResult / matchingBlocks / 'Bloco nao encontrado' block) with a single repository call, eliminating the need for ICarnivalBlocksRepository.getAllAsync in this cubit (though that method stays on the interface for other callers). The empty-invite-code early-return (lines 34-37), the current-user lookup (lines 42-48), the join-by-role-0 step (lines 68-73), and the error wrapping via _extractUserMessage are all preserved verbatim.

anchors: lines 22-31 — _extractUserMessage (KEEP — M1 will later extract this, but H2b does not touch it)
lines 50-65 — blocksResult = await _carnivalBlocksRepository.getAllAsync(); blocks.where((b) => b.inviteCode == inviteCode); matchingBlocks.first (REWRITE — call getByInviteCodeAsync instead)
lines 67-73 — _carnivalBlockMembersRepository.createAsync (KEEP — uses block.id from the new lookup)

reference_files.reason: After H2a, the interface has getByInviteCodeAsync; H2b imports that signature.

fix_shape: Replace the entire blocksResult / matchingBlocks / 'Bloco nao encontrado' block with: final blockResult = await _carnivalBlocksRepository.getByInviteCodeAsync(inviteCode); if (blockResult.isError()) { emit(JoinBlockError('Erro ao buscar bloco: ${_extractUserMessage(blockResult.exceptionOrNull())}')); return; } final block = blockResult.getOrNull()!; — and drop the matchingBlocks.isEmpty branch since a 404 from getByInviteCodeAsync becomes an Error result.
acceptance_criteria: A Failure result from getByInviteCodeAsync produces emit(JoinBlockError('Erro ao buscar bloco: ...')) with the same _extractUserMessage wrapping as the rest of the file

If H2a returned Failure(UnimplementedError) because the backend route does not yet exist, the cubit's error message clearly tells the user the backend is missing the endpoint — do NOT silently fall back to getAllAsync()
The empty-invite-code early-return, the current-user lookup, the join-by-role-0 step, the joinResult.fold, and the catch (e) branch are unchanged
JoinBlockState emissions are unchanged: JoinBlockInitial / JoinBlockLoading / JoinBlockError / JoinBlockSuccess
flutter analyze lib/ui/carnivalBlock/joinBlock/ returns no errors

grep_evidence: rg -n '_carnivalBlocksRepository\.getAllAsync' lib/ui/carnivalBlock/joinBlock/ must return zero matches
rg -n 'getByInviteCodeAsync' lib/ui/carnivalBlock/joinBlock/ must return at least one match

no_op_outside_scope: Do not touch _extractUserMessage (that is M1). Do not change JoinBlockState. Do not change the constructor or the cubit's public API. Do not change the join-by-role-0 step.
